en_US: Um, are you maybe on your way to
Snowpoint City?
That’s where I’m going, too.
If I use Fly, I can get there instantly,
but I’m walking for my training.
I have no problem with this.
I’m used to the cold because I go
barefoot and lightly dressed.
...Achoo!
Oh, that was nothing.
Really, I’m not cold at all.
I’ll be going now.
Please take care!
I’m using the Dowsing Machine on
my Pokétch.
I’m looking for things buried under
the snow.
The boulder is encrusted with ice.
It is bone chilling to touch.
Lake Acuity
A weathered violet expedition tent
stands in the snow. Nobody is here.
Embers still glow in a ring of
stones beside a split-log bench.
A lantern still burns on a supply
crate, beside an open field journal.
The handwriting is small and neat.
Day 9. The shard will not settle.
Every night it pulls to the south.
Day 12. Not up the mountain. Down.
Under it. Under all of that dark.
Teo, you always said I worried
too much. I'm coming anyway.
An Eclipse shard-compass hums
faintly in its open case.
Its dim violet needle points due
south... toward Mt. Coronet
and the molten depths beneath it.
